blender-modeler.modifications: Rebuilt as concise Blender modeling guidance; removed MCP workflow, unsupported fixed cleanup thresholds, unapproved delegates and hard budgets; added ResoLoop execution and ownership boundaries.

hard-surface.modifications: Retained form hierarchy, manufacturing seams, cutter organization, Boolean/bevel order and reusable detail; removed MCP, alternate-engine workflow, fixed bevel/poly budgets and unsupported delegates; added pivot and ResoLoop handoff guidance.

prop-artist.modifications: Adapted scale, tier-dependent attention, causal wear, reusable parts and functional pivots; removed fixed triangle/material budgets and non-ResoLoop handoffs; linked shared modular and set-dressing references and clarified runtime collision ownership.

uv-workflow.modifications: Kept seam, role-based density, overlap, packing, atlas and trim-sheet decisions; removed engine lightmap rules, universal budgets and MCP steps; clarified render-active UV0 preservation and non-default UDIM handling.

procedural-modeling.modifications: Retained parameterized systems, stable seeds, boundary testing and evaluated output; removed MCP and alternate-engine instructions, rejected treating different seeds as LODs, and added editable source/static-mesh handoff boundaries.

geometry-nodes.modifications: Kept reusable seeded authoring, scatter/building/curve validation and evaluated counts; removed MCP, other-engine instance claims and fixed instance caps; added API verification, source preservation, export-copy realization and ResoLoop ownership boundaries.

horror-style.modifications: Retained restrained environmental storytelling and optional spatial examples; removed MCP and unapproved style pack links; made fog, proportions, lighting and geometry choices optional, preserved navigation/readability, allowed requested modern technology, and clarified static-export limitations.

sci-fi-punk-worlds.modifications: Expanded the source's one-lane principle with concise sourced lane cues; scoped activation to explicit art direction and named locations, and framed cross-lane mixing as a local intentional exception.

dark-gritty-mood.modifications: Expanded terse mood cues into localized causal wear examples; avoided uniform noise, global lighting changes and invented material/shader rules; assigned final material and runtime review to standard skills.

brutalist-mood.modifications: Expanded brief form cues into concise massing and formwork guidance; scoped invocation to explicit architecture direction and separated monumental visual scale from usable route and collision verification.

modular-environment-design.md.modifications: Extracted grid intent and corner/edge/fill/trim/opening compatibility into a standalone module-design reference; removed environment orchestration, fixed kit counts, engine instructions and hard-coded dimensions.

set-dressing-patterns.md.modifications: Extracted narrative clusters, intentional density, negative space and clear travel/sightline principles; excluded whole-world composition, lighting and QA orchestration.

texture-baking.md.modifications: Extracted high-to-low normal projection, cage tuning, AO/curvature, atlas-region planning and margin review; excluded engine-specific channel packing, shader conventions and fixed resolution/margin prescriptions.
